select dsi.name, dsi.platform_name, dsi.site, dsi.charge_name, dsi.status, dsi.store_sign, dsi.create_user_name, dsi.create_time, dsi.update_user_name, dsi.update_time from dmp_shop_info dsi
and dsi.shop_name like concat('%',#{params.shopName},'%')
and dsi.platform_name like concat('%',#{params.platformName},'%')
and dsi.site like concat('%',#{params.site},'%')
and to_char(dsi.create_time,'yyyy-MM-dd') >= to_char(#{createTime_begin},'yyyy-MM-dd')
and to_char(dsi.create_time,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{params.createTime_end},'yyyy-MM-dd')
